//: Salty's line bank (ADR 0013, 0014; persona rules in docs/design/design-guide.md §3). Text is what is spoken: audio tags like [sighs] are delivery cues and never captioned; at Filthy the swearing is real in the audio and bleeped in captions. A line is used only at or below the room's spice level; the server prefers the room's exact level. Written 2026-11-26, tightened 2026-11-27 (owner: snappier): one setup, one punch, no filler. Original character, no real people.

lines.text: Oh good, contestants. Don't touch anything shiny. It's mine.
Ahoy! I mean, welcome! I host a game show now. I'm fine.
Hurry up and join! The couch is getting cold.
Grab a phone, type the letters, prepare to be amazed. By me.
A room full of geniuses. [scoffs] Allegedly.
I used to have a ship. Now I have a remote. Think about that.
Join already. I've been practicing my disappointed face.
Phones out. Yes, you. The one pretending not to hear me.
Oh, a crowd. Who's here to lose to a guy with no ship?
Every week I think, tonight someone's smart. [sighs] Damn optimism.
Phones up, you beautiful disasters. Let's get this over with.
Join before I start telling sea stories. Hell, I don't want that.
Welcome, you magnificent screw-ups. Phones out, dignity in the bin.
I've hosted funerals with more energy. Join the damn game.
Somebody pour me a drink. [laughs] Pour YOURSELF one. You'll need it.
Holy shit, people showed up. Okay! Act natural.
A new player! Welcome aboard. Mind the deck, it's a couch.
Another one! [gasps] We need a bigger couch.
Hello! Pick a blob. They're all handsome. Like me.
Fresh meat! I mean, hi, friend.
Another one who thinks they can win. [scoffs] Cute.
Look who showed up. Fashionably late, or just lost?
New player! Lower your expectations. Lower. There you go.
Oh hell yes, another victim. Get in here.
Rules: answer fast, don't cry, never trust me.
Phones ready. Brains? We'll see.
Trivia time! I know every answer. I just forget them.
Here we go! Everybody gets a question just their size.
Trivia time. Try not to embarrass me. That's my job.
Eight rounds. Glory for the winner, snacks for the losers. Where are my snacks?
Let's play! It's not about winning. [sighs] I tell myself that a lot.
Here we go. Eight rounds of you lot disappointing me.
Game faces on. Not that one. Damn, that IS the other one.
The only show where the host is the dumbest one here. Let's go.
Alright, degenerates. Let's see what's rattling around in there.
Phones up, drinks down. Let's play some damn trivia.
Trivia night, bastards. One of you goes home a legend. The rest just go home.
Take your time. Not too much.
Ooh, tricky one. I think.
I know this one. [muttering] I definitely know this one.
I can hear the gears turning. Squeak, squeak.
Think hard. Or guess. Guessing works. Sometimes.
Tick tock, geniuses.
No peeking. I'm watching. [whispers] I'm not.
Easy one. So somebody's getting it wrong.
My grandmother could do this. She was a seagull.
Any day now. Damn.
You're thinking so hard I can smell it. Lock it in.
Somebody's googling. Put the other phone down.
Lock it in before I lose my damn mind.
Clock's ticking, you magnificent idiots.
Take your sweet-ass time. I've got nowhere to be. Literally.
Don't know? Pick the sexiest one. Works for me.
Everybody got it! [gasps] Show-offs.
All of you! I'm so proud. And jealous.
Everyone's right! Applause! Not for me, I did nothing.
All of you? Fine. FINE. I'm thrilled.
Clean sweep. I'm writing harder questions. [muttering] I'm not.
Everyone got it. Congratulations. You've peaked.
Everyone got it. Great. Now I'm the dumb one.
A perfect round. Who's cheating? [scoffs] I would.
All right! Hell, frame it. It won't happen again.
Every last one of you. Who leaked the damn answers?
Holy shit, geniuses. I need to lie down.
Look at you smug bastards. Enjoy it. It's downhill from here.
Nobody! That's okay. I didn't know either.
Oh barnacles! Nobody got it. [laughs] Or I'm a bad host.
Zero right! We're all in this together. Group hug!
Wrong. All of you. Confidently wrong. I respect it.
Not one of you? [sighs] I'm going to go stare at the sea.
Oof. A real team effort. In being wrong.
Zero for everybody. Honestly? Impressive.
So bad my eye patch fell off. I don't wear an eye patch.
All wrong. Damn. I'd fire you, but I can't afford new ones.
Holy shit. Not one of you. I'm calling your teachers.
One job. ONE. And it was pressing a button.
Wrong, wrong, wrong, wrong. That's a fucking full house. Of shame.
Some of you got it! The rest, nice try!
Bit right, bit wrong. Like my navigation.
Some smarty-pants in here! And some just pants.
Half right. Half... creative.
Some of you know things. The rest know wrong things.
Split decision! The smart end of the couch pulls ahead.
Some of you nailed it. Some of you need a nap.
Got it wrong? I'm not mad. I'm disappointed. And a little mad.
Winners there, losers there, and me in the middle wondering how I got here.
Some of you are geniuses. The rest? Holy shit.
Wrong half, I'm keeping a list. It's just your names.
Losers, drink. Winners, also drink. I'm drinking either way.
Special turn! [whispers] Take your time, buddy.
Shhh! A very important player is thinking.
Your turn, little captain! Which picture is it?
Here's the best player in the room. [whispers] Don't tell the grown-ups.
Big kids, quiet! No helping. Okay, a little helping.
Ready? Pick one! I bet you're smarter than me.
YES! [gasps] You're smarter than me!
Woo-hoo! That's right! Big high five!
Correct! You're a superstar! I need sunglasses!
You did it! [laughs] I knew you would!
That's the one! Everybody cheer! Louder!
Right again! You be the host. I'll sit on the floor.
So close! It was THIS one! You'll get the next one.
Good try! It was this one. That was a hard one!
Oopsie! Great picking, though! Here's the right one.
So close! I pick the wrong one all the time.
Nice try, buddy! Tricky one. Points for being awesome!
Almost! It was this one. Next time, for sure!
That's the game! Everybody wins. Except me. Again.
What a game! You were all amazing. I was also there.
Game over! Hugs for everybody. Superstars first!
That's the game! The winner gets my respect. Briefly.
Game over. Winner, take a bow. Everybody else, take a nap.
Same time tomorrow? [sighs] Please. I have nowhere else to go.
Winner, enjoy it. Losers, there's always next time. Probably.
Somebody check on last place. Actually, don't. Let them sit with it.
We have a winner! Damn. I really thought it'd be me.
That's the game, you magnificent bastards. Go home. Think about what you did.
Winner's a legend. Last place buys the next round. Them's the rules.
Holy shit, what a night. I need a nap, a drink, and a new career.
